lines:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Services as Invocation Broker / Chat Lifecycle
    participant Committer as Event Committer
    participant Journal as Portable Runtime Journal
    participant Portable as Portable Commit Coordinator
    participant Recovery as Recovery Coordinator
    participant Worker as Worker Gateway

    Services->>Committer: CommitBatchV1 with lifecycle facts, CapabilityOutcomeV1 or WorkerCheckpointV1
    Committer->>Portable: PreparePortableCommitV1(CommitId, expected head, PortableCheckpointRecordV1)
    Portable-->>Committer: PreparedPortableCommitV1(request and object hashes, proposed head)
    Committer->>Journal: BeginPortableCommit(PortableRuntimeJournalEntryV1 and operational mutations)
    Journal-->>Committer: PendingPortableCommitDurableV1

    Committer->>Portable: PublishPreparedHeadV1(CommitId, expected head, proposed head)
    alt crash before portable head publication
        Note over Committer,Worker: No acknowledgement, dispatch, control, or outcome delivery was released
        Recovery->>Journal: Load pending entry by ChatId, BranchId, CommitId, machine and binding generation
        Journal-->>Recovery: exact expected and proposed heads, request hash, prepared object hashes and outboxes
        Recovery->>Portable: VerifyCommitIdentityV1(CommitId, expected head, proposed head)
        Portable-->>Recovery: NotPublishedV1(current verified head)
        alt expected head and exact prepared object set still match
            Recovery->>Committer: ResumeExactPreparedPublicationV1
            Committer->>Portable: PublishPreparedHeadV1 with the same identities and hashes
            Portable-->>Committer: PortableCommitReceiptV1
            Committer->>Portable: VerifyCommitIdentityV1 from a fresh read
            Portable-->>Committer: VerifiedPortableCommitV1
            Committer->>Journal: FinalizeHeadLinked(verified receipt)
            Journal-->>Committer: HeadLinkedDurableV1
            Committer-->>Services: CommittedReleaseV1
            Services-->>Worker: CoreCommittedAckV1, committed CapabilityOutcomeV1 or WorkerControlEnvelopeV1
        else head, prepared content, machine, or binding cannot be proven
            Recovery->>Committer: QuarantinePortableRuntimeBindingV1
            Committer->>Journal: QuarantineBinding(observed proof)
            Journal-->>Committer: QuarantinedV1
            Committer-->>Services: RecoveryBlockedV1 with no effect replay
        end
    else portable head publication returns
        Portable-->>Committer: PortableCommitReceiptV1
        alt crash after portable head publication but before HeadLinked
            Note over Committer,Worker: Portable history is canonical, but local release remains closed
            Recovery->>Journal: Load PendingPortableCommit
            Journal-->>Recovery: expected exact portable identity and local generation fences
            Recovery->>Portable: VerifyCommitIdentityV1 from the current branch ref
            alt CommitId, proposed head and checkpoint hash match
                Portable-->>Recovery: VerifiedPortableCommitV1
                Recovery->>Committer: FinalizeVerifiedHeadLinkV1
                Committer->>Journal: FinalizeHeadLinked(verified receipt)
                Journal-->>Committer: HeadLinkedDurableV1
                Committer-->>Services: CommittedReleaseV1
                Services-->>Worker: CoreCommittedAckV1, committed CapabilityOutcomeV1 or WorkerControlEnvelopeV1
            else head, branch, checkpoint, machine, or binding differs
                Portable-->>Recovery: CommitIdentityMismatchV1
                Recovery->>Committer: QuarantinePortableRuntimeBindingV1
                Committer->>Journal: QuarantineBinding(observed proof)
                Journal-->>Committer: QuarantinedV1
                Committer-->>Services: RecoveryBlockedV1 with no guessed adaptation
            end
        else uninterrupted verification
            Committer->>Portable: VerifyCommitIdentityV1 from a fresh read
            Portable-->>Committer: VerifiedPortableCommitV1
            Committer->>Journal: FinalizeHeadLinked(verified receipt)
            Journal-->>Committer: HeadLinkedDurableV1
            Committer-->>Services: CommittedReleaseV1
            Services-->>Worker: CoreCommittedAckV1, committed CapabilityOutcomeV1 or WorkerControlEnvelopeV1
        end
    end

    opt journal absent on another machine or inert import
        Recovery->>Portable: Read verified portable history only
        Portable-->>Recovery: portable branch and PortableCheckpointRecordV1
        Recovery-->>Services: InertPortableHistoryV1 requiring explicit fresh local rebinding
        Note over Services,Worker: No inherited authority, approval, dispatch, process generation, or continuation
    end

data.title: Portable runtime two-store commit, crash reconciliation, and inert import
